title: Google Finds Hackers Using AI Agents to Build and Run Exploits From Software Patches
content_md: Google on Monday revealed that adversarial use of artificial intelligence (AI) by threat actors has gone beyond manual prompting to deploying autonomous multi-agent offensive frameworks like ARTEX, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI, and PentAGI to execute multi-stage intrusions at greater operational velocity. In tandem, threat actors are leveraging the power and capabilities of large language models (LLMs)
